messages.author: 5bc0b352c8d95b37
messages.subject: Error with demo("Tokyo-compare")
parts:
Hi! Out of curiosity, I'm trying to understand the differences between INLA approach and MCMC approach and I found an error with demo("Tokyo-compare").

The following is the output I get on my laptop (which runs Windows): 

> demo("Tokyo-compare")


	demo(Tokyo-compare)
	---- ~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Type  <Return>	 to start : 

> ## RCSId = $Id: Tokyo-compare.R,v 1.7 2009/09/28 08:36:56 hrue Exp $
> ##
> ## this example show how to compare inla-results with MCMC using the
> ## buildt-in sampler using the simple Tokyo-example; see demo(Tokyo)
> 
> data(Tokyo)

> formula = y ~ f(time, model="rw2", cyclic=TRUE, param=c(1,0.0001)) - 1

> ## we need to keep the results in a known place
> wd.inla = tempfile()

> ## get the results using some important arguments..
> result = inla(formula, family="binomial", Ntrials=n, data=Tokyo,
+     ##
+     ## where to place the results
+     ##
+     working.directory = wd.inla,
+     ##
+     ## we need to keep the results
+     ##
+     keep=TRUE,
+     ##
+     ## this is to prevent the results to be stored in binary-format
+     ##
+     inla.arg = "")
Error in inla.interpret.vector(inla.read.binary.file(paste(file, .Platform$file.sep,  : 
  (len%%(2L * np + 2L)) == 0L is not TRUE
In addition: Warning message:
In matrix(inla.read.binary.file(file = paste(file, .Platform$file.sep,  :
  data length [1234] is not a sub-multiple or multiple of the number of rows [412]

> ## same with mcmc-results...
> wd.mcmc = tempfile()

> ## same as before
> result = inla(formula, family="binomial", Ntrials=n, data=Tokyo,
+     ##
+     ## where to place the results
+     ##
+     working.directory = wd.mcmc,
+     ##
+     ## we need to keep the results
+     ##
+     keep = TRUE,
+     ##
+     ## secret options to inla: 5000 iterations using thinning of 10
+     ## and the scaling of the hyperparmeter proposal is 1.
+     ##
+     inla.arg = "-m mcmc -N 5000 -T 10 -S 1")
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does not help, please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.



I think that the problem is related to the inla.arg parameter since if I run the first model without setting it then it runs without any problem (of course I cannot use the same approach for the MCMC model, i.e. ignore the inla.arg parameter).

How could I fix this? I tried looking for some documentation on the inla arguments but I didn't find anything useful. Could you suggest me something?

This is not an important problem (at least for my projects) since I think I can ignore the MCMC comparison but I still wanted to report this error.

As always, thank you for your assistance on all my questions.

Kind regards
Andrea
